texts.arguments: 6. The learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioners would vehemently contend that this becomes a classic illustration of 8 Section 354 of the IPC or even Section 506 of the IPC. The persons who are working in United States of America are also drawn as accused Nos. 1 and 2 who have nothing to do with the happenings in Bangalore and all those who are drawn into the web of crime in Sri. Gautham Ramamurthy vs State Of Karnataka on 22 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149223729/ 6 Bangalore also have nothing to do with the allegations made. The non-performer or a poor performer who was asked to perform, refuses to perform her duties and has, therefore, faced termination. The termination leads to registration of crime for offences under Sections 354 and 506 of the IPC. He would submit that if the correspondences between the petitioners and the complainant are noticed, the proceedings cannot but be termed to be an abuse of the process of law. He would seek quashment of the entire crime. Touching the complainant inappropriately can undoubtedly become a crime under Section 354 of the IPC. All that the complainant sought was freedom of movement and her belongings to be returned, which were snatched 9 away in an unceremonious manner. She was also removed in an unceremonious manner. Therefore, the complainant had to reach the jurisdictional Police for want of Committee in the organization to redress grievances of sexual harassment within the Company - the Internal Complaints Committee or the posh Committee as it is known. She would submit that registering a complaint before the Internal Complaints Committee is not a pre-requisite to register a crime under Section 354 of the IPC.
